scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @farm-connect/frontend" "npm run dev -w @farm-connect/backend"

scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w @farm-connect/contracts && npm run build -w @farm-connect/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @farm-connect/contracts && npm run test -w @farm-connect/backend && npm run test -w @farm-connect/frontend
